title: An adoption funnel for supplier comparisons
method: Synthetic two-cycle cohort. Counts refer to the same 120 eligible people, with each stage a subset of the previous stage. Completion is an accepted supplier comparison. Changes in task opportunity can affect the funnel; the chart does not estimate industry adoption.
alt: An adoption funnel for supplier comparisons. Eligible: 120 eligible people, Saw invitation: 90 eligible people, Started: 60 eligible people, Completed: 42 eligible people, Returned next cycle: 30 eligible people. Illustrative data.
